Episode 175. Goldsmith (1)
The seabed where Veil woke up had now become a kind of air-raid shelter.
"Hedo! At this rate, we'll pass three days. What if something happens to Jin?"
Sandra stomped her feet and yelled. Hedo silently looked up at the sky, watching the fight between Jin and the unidentified divine entity known as Veil.
Today is April 24, 1803.
The battle between Jin and Veil had been ongoing without resolution for more than two and a half days. No one expected the fight to last this long.

Moreover, Jin and Veil chose the sea surface, not the seabed, as the stage. Those who came with them naturally thought that Veil would have the advantage due to spatial constraints, but Jin was prolonging the battle by leveraging his characteristics as a magic swordsman.
"I wouldn't have listened to Jin's request if I knew this would happen. Ah, that Veil doesn't listen to my commands anymore! I've yelled at him to stop several times."

"…It's not that he's not listening, he can't hear. The tomb giants have set up a thick protective barrier. Why don't you go over there, wash your face, or get some sleep. Your eyes are so red they look like they're about to burst."
At Hedo's words, the tomb giants nodded as if agreeing.

Most of the buildings formed on the seabed were like altars for Veil, but like religious facilities, bathrooms and washrooms existed. Thanks to this, those who remained on the seabed were watching the battle in relative comfort.

Of course, their bodies were not uncomfortable, but their minds were agitated. The Bamel alliance was extremely worried about Jin getting hurt, and Hedo felt sick just thinking about the situation after the battle.
Still, even amid their distress, those on the seabed often lost themselves in the moment. This was because the battle between Jin and Veil was producing superb moments that unwittingly drew them in.
Hedo, in particular, admired the spectacle as a warrior.

'Is it because of the prestige of the 12th generation? Veil's authority to explode the dragons of chaos in the air has not manifested even once…… While Veil is fighting viciously, the 12th generation is focusing on breaking their own barriers.'
He wondered if such a battle was possible, but to Hedo's eyes, Jin seemed to be training, not fighting.
Crash-!

The frozen seawater that Jin was standing on cracked, causing a spray of water. It was Jin's magic power that was freezing the seawater, and he had been fighting like this, forming ground to stand on, for two days straight.
This was a stark contrast to the earlier situation where Padler's group quickly fell into a disadvantage due to not overcoming the spatial limits.
The constantly changing natural landscape made the fight seem not between a human and a divine entity, but a confrontation between two divine entities.
[You are tenacious. But can you see the end now? When you're finished, Sara and I will go far away…….]
"Crazy guy."
Jin said, standing on the newly formed ice.
Unlike at first, he no longer respected Veil. Through fighting, often mixing words with his sword, he found Veil unworthy of his respect.
This translation may not be perfect due to the complex nature of the text, but here is my best effort:
It was nothing more than an insane obsession with Sarah, the former tenth knight.
After Sarah's death, he went berserk, destroying the world and was expelled from the tenth knights, a dishonorable being who was likely sealed here for that reason.
Even after waking up after a thousand years, he is denying reality and perceiving Sandra as Sarah, Jin feels not just disrespect for Veil, but also disgust.
[You don't give up, I admit, so Sarah must like you. She has always liked such people. But what are you going to do with that tired body now?]
Jin fought as efficiently as possible, but the battle was so long that minor injuries and fatigue were inevitable.
On the other hand, Veil was the same as at the beginning. Just as Runtia in the void did, Veil was using a nearly infinite power.
He usually healed minor injuries immediately, and even wounds that would have been fatal to a human were restored within minutes.
Like Runtia, you can't cut off the source of infinite power. Veil's power is not transmitted from the void, but is entirely his own.

[You don't seem to have enough power to freeze the seawater anymore? You can barely stand on your two feet. You've been fighting noisily all the time. You must still have some spells left, I recommend you bring them out and use them.]
As he said, the frozen seawater under Jin's feet was extremely narrow. It was not firmly fixed, and it didn't seem stable enough to move like on the ground.
Yet Jin was unusually composed. Even though he was panting and bleeding from various wounds on his body, and physical limits were slowly approaching.
In fact, Jin never expected he could be so calm.
In the long and fierce battle, Jin was gaining some enlightenment.
‘I felt like I could never overpower him just two days ago... now it seems like I can do it anytime.'
Rank Hallowbatch, Smarion Proch, Total Attack of the Garden of Swords, Runtia Runcandel, Fake Yona, and up to now.
After returning to Inseo from Rapralosa, Jin has been constantly fighting.
All the experience of these battles is waking Jin up all at once through the battle with Veil.

“At first, I hoped that you would come to your senses while fighting me. Accepting the death of Lady Sarah, I wanted you to calmly hear about her last moments and the will she left for me. If you really loved Lady Sarah, I thought that was inevitable.”
[Sarah is waiting for me down there.]

"But what are you showing now? You just babbled nonsense. You're scared to accept Lady Sarah's death, so you're messing around. She loved Runcandel, and she lived like a never-extinguishing fire for the sake of saving the world.”
[Shut up!]

"Lady Sarah is one person, and no one can replace her. So stop insulting Lady Sarah, you only used her for your selfish desires, not love. You rant as if you'd die without Lady Sarah, but knowing that she's no longer in this world, you've chosen the weak option of denying reality instead of grieving or continuing her legacy."
Veil swung his sword and wings at Jin. The sword energy and golden aura violently turned the sea over, but Jin didn't lose his balance as if he were a phantom.
It was the result of draining the shock.
Veil didn't care. Throughout the last battle, Jin had been dodging his attacks this way, stalling for time, so there was no need for him to be particularly concerned.
But for some reason, Veil felt a chill run down his spine.
'Is he about to unleash his hidden move? The Flame of Ruin, or maybe the Spirit Sword or the Sword of the Demon King?'
Regardless of what it was, Veil was certain he could handle it.

He could clearly see how much power Jin had left in his eyes. If Jin had been preparing his techniques from the beginning, it might be a different story, but it seemed unlikely that Jin could exert enough power to threaten him now, no matter what he did.
Whoosh...!
The blue flame that had just started to engulf the Bradamante was made of meager magic.
Magic was the power that Jin had used the most up until now. He had no choice but to keep using it to freeze the sea.
Veil couldn't understand why Jin intended to unfold his final technique through magic rather than spirit power or lightning power.
'Your Flame of Ruin, which you claimed to have received directly from Sara two days ago, was quite plausible, but this... you can't even imitate her flame.'
Veil continued to bombard Jin with his sword energy and power, while Jin remained unmoved.
"This is not Lady Sara's Flame of Ruin, Veil."
As Jin answered in a calm voice, Veil exploded his power with a roar instead of responding.
As if a wild beast was merely barking, avoiding direct contact with a torch, Veil continued to stick to ranged attacks.
He should be falling, but he's not falling.
Jin felt the same to Veil right now. Just like Jin wasn't falling, the weak flame that enveloped Bradamante wasn't going out.
The moment Veil wondered why,
Jin met his eyes and smiled. Hedo, who had been watching from the seabed, knew this was the moment Jin would break through the wall. Only Hedo recognized that fact.
"You probably can't understand why I'm not falling despite being exhausted, and why this weak flame isn't going out. And your instinct is telling you not to close the distance with me."
The face of Veil, who had never lost his composure, was quickly becoming anxious.
'...What is that flame?'
Veil thought he was superior in every way. Jin's energy was at its lowest, while he was in the same state as at the beginning.
But his thoughts were quickly changing now.
The certainty that he would surely fall if he touched that fire put pressure on Veil's entire body.
"A flame that started from Lady Sara and has finally become entirely mine."
The flame attached to Bradamante remained blurry.
Since this was its completed form, there was no need for it to change into a more intimidating shape. In other words, whether Jin was exhausted or full, it always remained the same.
A new demon sword, yet to be named.
In essence, Jin created a unique ultimate technique while fighting with Veil.
With that sword unfurled for the first time, Jin began to approach Veil slowly. The frozen sea water was forming a stair-like path to match his steps.
"Whether this flame becomes your new milestone, or a weapon that confines you, depends on you."
Veil charged at Jin with all his might.

But just before his sword could reach, he flinched and stopped. He had rushed in with excitement, but as soon as the blades started to clash, it seemed like he would be quickly subdued by that strange flame.
"I'm giving you one last chance. Think carefully about your answer to the question I'm about to ask, Veil."
Who is the person down there now?
At that question, Veil kept his eyes closed for a while, not uttering a word. His closed cross-eyes were trembling.
"...Zifl."
"Yes, Lady Sara died a thousand years ago. The person you believed was Sara is the descendant of her nemesis, Zifl, and my companion."
"Why are you waking me up, revealing such a horrifying truth? What have I done wrong to you? In this horrific world, I can't even die as I wish... It's cruel."
Jin felt a little sorry for Veil's reaction.
The first time Veil seemed to have a real conversation, he was like a young beast without even the minimal shell to protect himself.
It felt like the great sorrow Veil finally accepted with Sara's death was being transferred to him as well.
However, regardless of the sadness, Jin had to keep pressing him.
-'Sara! If she is dead, I will destroy the whole world!'

Because he might start running to fulfill the words he spat out as soon as he woke up. According to Kikantel, he already had a history of rampaging and destroying the world every day a thousand years ago, due to Sara's death.
"So, are you going to destroy the world now?"
At those words, Veil let out a hollow laugh.
"If that woman named Sandra Zifl wants it, I suppose I have to."
"Ha, even after realizing it's not Lady Sara but Sandra Zifl, you won't stop that madness... Wait a minute, Veil. Don't tell me?"
Suddenly, the conversation between Veil and Sandra two days ago rose like ominous smoke in Jin's mind.
-'It's okay now, Sara. You've changed from what I remember, lost your right arm and become weaker... but now I'll protect you. As you protected me.'
-Will you protect me?
-'Yes, Sara Run Kandel. My life, soul, and power exist solely for you.'
"The Oath... you've already pledged an oath to Sandra, imposing the Oath on yourself?"
Veil nodded weakly.
